on my machine this results in 

dcb03a9fe66d753348154c41f5b40927125723aa is the first bad commit
commit dcb03a9fe66d753348154c41f5b40927125723aa
Author: Lee moon soo <moon@apache.org>
Date:   Wed May 13 01:45:30 2015 +0200

    Simplify classpath.

    When Zeppelin constructs JVM CLASSPATH, it adds path of every single jar. That creates really long CLASSPATH and it may cause some problem like https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-68.
    This PR solves it by constructing CLASSPATH with wildcard.

    Another problem is, Zeppelin constructs CLASSPATH with duplicated entry or not related entry.
    This PR solves it by constructing CLASSPATH not in common.sh but in each script zeppelin-daemon.sh, interpreter.sh, zeppelin.sh while they need different entry in CLASSPATH.

    Author: Lee moon soo <moon@apache.org>

    Closes #65 from Leemoonsoo/ZEPPELIN-68 and squashes the following commits:

    ae3ea5a [Lee moon soo] Print rat.txt when build failed
    4eee837 [Lee moon soo] ZEPPELIN-68 simplify classpath

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: Can confirm a similar error. I need to build with -DskipTests for the build to succeed.
I'd like to note that this could be related to trying to build with Java 8 however.

Same here, when I build with mvn clean package -Pspark-1.6 -Phadoop-2.4 tests fail with

18:28:47,426  INFO org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.remote.RemoteInterpreterProcess:108 - Run interpreter process [../bin/interpreter.sh, -d, nonexists, -p, 57652]
18:28:47,427  INFO org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.remote.RemoteInterpreterUtils:50 - Exception in RemoteInterpreterUtils while checkIfRemoteEndpointAccessible
java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused

When I do not set SPARK_HOME, I can still run Zeppelin and submit Spark jobs no problem.
If I try to use my Spark version installed via brew, running paragraphs result in the "Connection refused" error after a timeout. Increasing zeppelin.interpreter.connect.timeout did not help.

I have successfully compiled and run Zeppelin w/ Java 8 before
